messages:
alex: Heads up — canary for onboarding v4.1.0 (PR #3421) is showing a p95/p99 latency jump in staging at ~03:12 UTC. Notable increase in KV evictions too. Pausing rollout? /cc @maria @jonathan
ci-bot: CI perf run staging-eval/model-onboard shows p99 +45% vs baseline, p95 +22%. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/9876 :warning:
maria: I inspected profiler traces — KV cache hit rate dropped ~98% -> ~74% on the bad runs. Eviction count spiked. That points to different tokenization or prefix alignment causing cache mismatches.
jonathan: Quick profiler snippet from one affected host:
```
kernel_selector: chosen=attn_fallback_v2 reason=max_seq_estimate>128
kv_cache: hit_rate=0.74 evictions=423
batcher: window=8 selected_batching=latency-first
```
jonathan: Fallback kernel is noticeably slower on long tails. The selector flipped to fallback because the sequence-length estimator grossly overshot for many requests.
nico: Any tokenizer changes in this onboard? EOS / special token mappings can nudge length estimators.
alex: Yes — PR #3421 removed an explicit EOS marker for some locales to better align tokens with training data. That change shifts average sequence-end positions for a subset of prompts — looks like it confuses the batcher/selector heuristics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/3421
maria: Recommend bisecting the merge range to confirm correlation, and enable per-request kernel_selector logging so we can capture real examples (input/estimated_len/choice).
jonathan: Kicked off bisect: `tools/bisect_perf --range=main~20..main --target=staging-onboard` (run: https://ci.internal/bisects/551). Early signal: tokenizer config commit narrows it down.
deploy-bot: Automatic policy halt: shadow rollout of v4.1.0 in region-us-west paused (reason: kernel-mismatch + perf delta).
ci-bot: Bisect concluded: commit `abcdef1` (tokenizer config tweak) correlates with p99 jump. Introduced 2024-11-02T03:12Z.
jonathan: Proposed short-term mitigation: pin tokenizer config to previous version in canary and add a kernel-selector override to prefer `attn_fast_v1` for avg_seq_est <= 128. Patch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3432
alex: Can we ship hotfix quickly? If not, revert PR #3421 to stop further rollouts. Maria/SRE please coordinate rollback plan.
sre: Alert created PERF-ONBOARD-3344 and dashboard pinned: https://dashboards.internal/perf/3344. I'll run a steady-state 30m load once the hotfix or revert is in to validate.
maria: I'll prepare both a hotfix branch (config pin + selector logging) and a revert PR. Hotfix first unless we see immediate risk.
nico: Also add a regression unit test for kernel-selector: assert stable kernel choice for common prompt profiles and for the tokenizer outputs we changed. That should catch this earlier.
alex: :thumbsup: Good plan. Post bisect artifacts and sample requests here so infra/team can reproduce locally. Keep thread updated.
